doc_title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast, Determination of Interim Dividend, and Revision of Year-end Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 「業績予想の修正」ならびに「剰余金の配当（中間配当）の決定」および「期末配当予想の修正（増配）」に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 中間期実績および通期業績目標の修正を踏まえて

summary_en: The Shiga Bank raised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 to 55 yen per share (annual), up 5 yen from the previous forecast of 50 yen, following an upward revision of earnings guidance. Interim dividend was increased to 27.50 yen per share from 25.00 yen, with the year-end dividend also raised to 27.50 yen.
summary_jp: 滋賀銀行は2027年3月期の年間配当予想を前回の50円から55円に引き上げた。中間配当を25円から27円50銭に、期末配当も27円50銭に引き上げており、いずれも実績および業績目標の修正に基づく。
